title: L-system tree (procedural)
notes: Stochastic L-system grammar (5 iterations) expanded by a 3D turtle into ~3-5k line segments forming a recognizable branching tree. 80k particles distributed across segments proportional to length, jittered slightly off-axis for fuzzy bark. Generation-graded palette: bark brown at trunk → mossy green at mid-branches → bright lime at tips. Sway intensity scales with generation so tips move while trunk holds. Click to regrow with new random seed. Procedural — no asset dependency, but produces a real tree shape.
